Ana (CS): FYI capture: Pulsewave is signalling an expansion — new ContentOps team + two new use cases. Putting details here so we can coordinate enablement and capacity. @Devon @Sam :eyes:
Maya (Pulsewave): thanks Ana. yep — ContentOps will own realtime article summarization and a small reranking pipeline. Going to onboard 6 folks, expect peak embedding QPS ~600 and gen QPS ~120 during campaigns.
Devon (SE): 600 embed qps peak is notable. Are those single-call embeddings or batched? avg tokens per call? also region/residency reqs?
Maya (Pulsewave): mostly single-call embeddings from client-side, avg 384 dims, payload ~700 tokens per doc ingest. Region: US only for now. No special residency.
Sam (Onboard): got it. Proposed path: 1) short technical kickoff w/ SEs 2) quota bump trial + dedicated pilot for 2 weeks 3) enablement workshop for ContentOps (runbook + best prompts). Can we land kickoff next Wed?
Ana (CS): sounds good. Renewal health is green but this expansion could drive commit. Recommend offering a managed pilot (discounted) to de-risk performance and lock-in.
Devon (SE): if we do a dedicated pilot I suggest these steps: - baseline perf on current model variants - test prefix caching on summarization flows - try small quantized model variant for embeddings to drop unit costs. Also need example traffic trace (JSON sample) and TL;DR of SLA expectations.
Maya (Pulsewave): I can share traces. SLA: soft target 200ms p95 for summarization, embeddings <150ms p95. Can we hit that with batching off?
Devon (SE): p95 200ms summarization is tight but possible with optimized kernels and shorter context. We'll validate in pilot. For embeddings 150ms p95 likely with dedicated GPUs + caching.
Ana (CS): action items: Maya -> share traces by EOD Tue; Devon -> draft pilot scope + perf checklist; Sam -> calendar invite for kickoff + enablement doc stub. I'll propose a pilot discount term. :rocket:
ops-bot: Automated note — account pulsewave-prod flagged: potential quota bump requested + pilot tag added.
Maya (Pulsewave): thanks team. Appreciate quick turnaround. I'll upload traces to shared drive and ping you.
Devon (SE): noted. prepping checklist now.
Sam (Onboard): I'll send the invite and the enablement agenda today. :)
Ana (CS): tagging renewals and AE to keep in loop. this looks like a strong expansion signal — marking as high-priority for CS ops.
